uniqueRepairPhotoPolicy.photoSlotScope: global DOM photo slot ID; one provider ID, landing page and normalized URL can be assigned once per browser profile; 64-bit dHash/pHash is checked where browser CORS permits
uniqueRepairPhotoPolicy.visualFallbackType: topic-specific SVG illustration, visibly labelled as illustration, never counted as a photograph

dynamicProvider.name: Openverse + Wikimedia Commons
dynamicProvider.searches: FIX111: every image slot across every pre-rendered view is tracked at startup, but provider downloads run only in the active view and for near-viewport cards. Hidden tabs and off-screen cards are observed and activated on navigation/scroll; they do not consume Openverse or Commons requests before use. Homepage module/specialist seeds are prioritized and ownership-migrated before provider search. Dynamic lesson/method/tool/course cards are queued when inserted and fetched when visible/near viewport. Topic/license filters, global single assignment, bounded provider backoff and the shared daily request budget remain enforced.
dynamicProvider.licenseRules: Openverse CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and PDM only; Wikimedia CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA only; reject NonCommercial, missing author, missing landing page and unsafe HTTP URLs.
dynamicProvider.offlineFallback: Unique, topic-specific SVG illustration with explicit offline label; it is not counted as a photograph.
dynamicProvider.anonymousOpenverseAccess: supported; request throttling and pagination limits are respected
dynamicProvider.searchBehavior: FIX129: equipment-only metadata filter rejects people, faces, hands, classrooms, technicians and workers before assignment; online providers remain enabled for licensed, topic-matched computer hardware/electronics photographs.
dynamicProvider.homepagePriority: 3 hero photos + 6 slideshow images + 6 new module cards; prioritized before remaining loaded catalog slots
dynamicProvider.onlinePhotoGuardCompatibility: FIX93: accepts verified catalog assignment markers in both legacy FIX77 and FIX83 visual audits; all other unregistered external rasters remain blocked.
dynamicProvider.strictVramEvidence: GDDR3-GDDR7/HBM/VRAM/graphics-memory IC evidence required; rejects DIMM, SO-DIMM, UDIMM, desktop/system RAM and all RAM modules.
dynamicProvider.strictRamEvidence: Requires DDR2-DDR6 or DIMM/SO-DIMM/UDIMM or explicit computer RAM module/stick; rejects SD cards, flash cards, cartridges, floppy disks, tapes and old storage media.
dynamicProvider.topicMismatchHandling: Reject candidate before assignment; retain clearly labelled topic-specific offline illustration; continue category-specific pagination and retry after cooldown.
dynamicProvider.strictPortEvidence: Requires USB-C connector/port on a computer/laptop or clearly named laptop charging port; generic charging lights, transit USB ports and unrelated USB-C accessories are rejected.
dynamicProvider.commonsTransientRetry: network, HTTP 408, 429, 503 and 5xx with bounded exponential backoff
dynamicProvider.openverseDailyBudgetScope: Openverse only; does not block Wikimedia Commons fallback retries
dynamicProvider.searchQueuePolicy: Track all eligible slots at boot and on insertion. Fetch active-view near-viewport images only; queue hidden/off-screen images on navigation/scroll/IntersectionObserver. Homepage cards receive first priority while visible; hidden cards do not spend the provider quota.
dynamicProvider.seedAssignmentRecovery: FIX111 detects curated seed IDs from persisted seedId/providerId/URL/page; removes misowned or mismatched legacy assignments so primary homepage slots can reclaim their reserved photos.

searchBehavior: FIX109: the whole document is scanned at startup; all eligible slots in visible and hidden views are placed into one progressive global queue. Active view slots receive first priority, then homepage slots, then remaining views. Dynamically inserted cards are queued immediately. Openverse budget, Wikimedia independent retry, strict license/topic checks and global no-duplicate assignment remain enforced. FIX115: reject diagrams, flowcharts, schematics, infographics, screenshots and vector/illustration media even when their tags mention training; certification photographs require an education/classroom context, people and computer/electronics equipment. Persisted FIX111 assignments and candidate pools are revalidated under the same policy.

onlinePhotoGuardCompatibility.missingPhotoIdRecovery: deterministic nodeInfo id from the actual image wrapper, alt text and context
onlinePhotoGuardCompatibility.svgFallbackOwnership: only the licensed photo catalog handles catalog-owned image errors; FIX77/FIX83 must not replace them before the catalog retry
onlinePhotoGuardCompatibility.visualUniquenessFix83: FIX93_CATALOG_IMAGE_ERROR_OWNER: katalogowe fotografie HTTPS z markerem photo-fix90-online i potwierdzonym przypisaniem są pomijane przez stary SVG fallback; zdarzenie error jest obsługiwane przez katalog.
onlinePhotoGuardCompatibility.photoUniquenessFix77: FIX93_LEGACY_PHOTO_GUARD_OWNER: zatwierdzone fotografie katalogowe nie są ograniczane do historycznej puli 13 lokalnych zdjęć; zwykłe zewnętrzne obrazy bez przypisania nadal są blokowane.

curation.manualSeedPolicy: Every seed was checked against its actual title/description and license page; a category label alone is never evidence.
topicRules: GDDR3 VRAM chips separate from RAM modules
GPU graphics card and GPU cooling
curation.peopleAndHandsPolicy: FIX129: source metadata mentioning people, faces, hands, classroom groups, technicians or workers is rejected before display.
curation.homepageSeedPolicy: FIX129 curation retained in FIX131 same-origin delivery: 19 unique topic-matched equipment/electronics seeds; metadata filter excludes people and hands.

homepageCoverage.policy: FIX129 equipment-only source curation + FIX131 same-origin photo delivery + FIX135 complete one-to-one static coverage for all 19 homepage module cards; six specialist cards remain dynamically topic-matched. SVG is the labelled offline fallback.

photoQueuePolicy.methodRendererHandoff: service-workshop.js registers each freshly rendered method card after initial render, search and category changes; the global observer tracks every slot, while fetches occur only when the active view and viewport make the card relevant.
photoQueuePolicy.methodAssignmentMigration: FIX115 revalidates FIX111/FIX109/FIX108 assignments by photo-vs-diagram media type, topical category and exact homepage slot; mismatches are removed before the new reserved curated seed is selected.
photoQueuePolicy.methodRendererQueueHandoffDetails: The MutationObserver discovers dynamic cards in any view. Their network fetch is deferred until the containing view is active and the card is within the viewport margin. The 147 method cards are processed as the visitor opens and scrolls the methods view.
photoQueuePolicy.homeSeedOwnershipPolicy: 21 primary homepage seeds are reserved for their matching module or specialist slot; method/tool/course slots cannot consume them.
photoQueuePolicy.policyDescription: FIX111: every photo slot is registered and observed, but network downloads run only for the active view near the viewport. Hidden tabs wait for navigation; distant cards wait for scrolling. This preserves provider quotas and keeps homepage seed ownership reserved.
imageSlotCoverage: repair list and detail photo stages
photoQueuePolicy.seedOwnershipMigrationPolicy: Curated source identity is resolved by seedId, providerId, canonical URL or source page. A reserved homepage seed cannot remain assigned to a method/course/tool/other homepage slot.
photoQueuePolicy.pwaPhotoCacheStrategy: Service Worker caches cross-origin image requests for Pexels/Wikimedia, then serves the opaque cached image response offline.

seedAssignmentRecovery: FIX115 revalidates every stored FIX111/FIX109 assignment against media type, category and exact homepage slot before restoring. Invalid or stale assignments are removed; reserved curated seeds are then preferred again.

homepagePhotoFirstRenderFix.mappingPolicy: one-to-one exact slot/category mapping; all 19 homepage module cards have curated photo seeds
